verdict.rationale: skills.sh's CLI explicitly supports non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly installation (`-y` flag, `--agent`, `--skill` targeting) and this was confirmed via runtime probe showing it auto-detects agent-driven contexts and switches to promptless mode; it also supports lockfile-based restoration (`experimental_install`) useful for reproducible CI setups. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions config) or dedicated CI docs page, and community notes raise concerns about missing package-management features like version pinning.
